profile_text.body:
Fiddler is an enterprise AI governance and observability company whose platform it describes as an "AI Control Plane" for managing both agentic and predictive AI deployments. The platform is designed to give organizations visibility, monitoring, policy enforcement, and auditable governance across AI systems throughout their lifecycle, from creation through production. The company says its typical users include software and AI engineers, data scientists, platform and DevOps teams, and security and compliance teams, with particular focus on regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, insurance, and government.

The core product, Fiddler AI, covers model performance management, explainability, bias detection, drift monitoring, and LLM observability. A notable component is Fiddler Centor Models, which the company says run within a customer's own environment to power guardrails and evaluations without external LLM API calls, and which Fiddler claims reduce evaluation total cost of ownership by up to 98% compared to foundation models. The platform also handles detection and redaction of PII, PHI, and secrets at the prompt and response level, and records enforcement decisions for audit purposes in line with GRC standards. Fiddler describes the platform as model- and cloud-agnostic, supporting Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, LangGraph, and more than 100 other providers.

The site's held facts confirm Fiddler has a tracked presence on theworldofai.org under the AI Governance and Risk Management Platforms category. No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are currently held for the company.
